required_capabilities.description: Preserve and evaluate text with stable page-aware structure without document-type semantics.
Preserve structured row/cell/path semantics instead of flattening a table to prose.
Preserve finite audio/video as timed media with derivative transcripts kept separate.
Reopen exact textual evidence from the frozen Representation.
Reopen exact structured table evidence by row/cell/path and observed values.
Reopen exact start/end timed evidence against the original recording.
Recover materially distinct propositions from a long source containing many topics.
Preserve who said, requested, decided, reported, or authored something when source evidence supports it.
Preserve conditions, exceptions, scope and cross-references that materially change a proposition.
Extract quantitative/categorical facts without losing table structure, labels or value types.
